link.note: Pelletreau (App. p. 479) lists Francis among James & Jerusha's sons; Orange County militia records place him at Woodbury Clove.

summary: Brother of Temperance Smith — uncle of Keturah Tuttle (John's 7th-great-grand-uncle); captain of the Woodbury Clove militia company in 1775–76, under whom Thomas Lamoreaux was ensign.
bio: Ruttenber & Clark (1881): 'Woodbury Clove Co.—1775—Francis Smith, captain; Thomas Smith, 1st lt.; ... 1776—... Thos. Lammoreux, ensign.' SAR P-232580 says Thomas Lamoreaux served as Ensign under Capt. Francis Smith and Colonel Woodhull.
